record.title: Stainless Steel Food-Contact Utensils - Hygiene and Material Requirements
record.description:
Specifies material, finish, corrosion resistance, cleanability, and marking requirements for stainless steel utensils and kitchenware intended for repeated food contact.

Applies to ladles, serving utensils, bowls, trays, and similar stainless steel kitchenware used in domestic or institutional food preparation and serving.

Key requirements: Food-contact surfaces shall use the declared stainless-steel grade or an approved equivalent within the demo specification.; Surfaces shall be reasonably smooth and cleanable for the intended use.; Joints and seams shall not create avoidable food-retention pockets in areas declared as food contact.; Products shall resist the defined corrosion screening exposure.

Testing requirements: Material identification verification.; Corrosion resistance screening under the defined exposure.; Surface finish and cleanability inspection.; Dimensional and workmanship checks.

Documentation required: Material grade certificate or supplier declaration.; Production inspection checklist.; Laboratory corrosion test report where applicable.; Product drawing or dimensional specification.

Marking requirements: Manufacturer identification or trade mark.; Product/model identification.; Batch or lot mark where traceability is claimed.; Material grade designation where required by the product specification.
record.certification_applicability: Certification is not automatically required by the standard alone; it may become applicable through a product-specific order or contractual specification.
